data.name: Jignasa
data.gender_notes: Jignasa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jignasa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jñāna’, meaning knowledge. Jignasa signifies a person with an insatiable thirst for knowledge and understanding. It embodies the spirit of inquiry and curiosity, reflecting the desire to explore the depths of life and unravel its mysteries. The name Jignasa carries the meaning “Desire, Curiosity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jignasa usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, curiosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Jignasa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire, Curiosity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jignasa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
